name: Kiral Horchata-Saffron Mist
description: A lightly carbonated horchata-style soda infused with synth-saffron and a whisper of rose, delivering a creamy, floral softness that sits somewhere between a dessert drink and an afternoon refresher. Mid-tier positioning but beloved by Tier 2 workers as a small daily luxury.
flavor_profile: Creamy rice-milk sweetness, warm saffron bloom, faint rose water finish, gentle effervescence
slogan: Soft as the day before it starts.
cultural_context: Kiral Horchata-Saffron Mist became a fixture in Tier 2 break rooms and corner canteens — the drink you crack open when a shift finally ends. Its slightly nostalgic, comforting profile makes it a go-to for workers who grew up on sweeter, creamier drinks. It's not glamorous, but it has genuine loyalty.
story_hooks: A canteen supplier in the Shelf's border districts is quietly watering down Kiral stock and pocketing the difference — someone notices the taste is off and starts pulling threads.
A Tier 3 food blogger insists the synth-saffron in Kiral is actually a masked compound with mild mood-stabilizing properties — the company neither confirms nor denies.
Two childhood friends from different tiers recognize each other after years apart when one orders a Kiral — it was the only drink both their families could afford.
